Manières neuves face au parent (tenir la porte, appeler pour les grandes nouvelles, dire bonjour en entrant, s'habiller un peu pour dîner, téléphone hors de la table, une bonne histoire). Sophia sur la dernière à la première personne (cta A). old fashioned manners
worth bringing back

1. holding the door

for whoever is behind you.
always.

2. calling instead of texting
for important news

3. saying "good morning"
when you walk into a room

4. dressing up a little
for dinner

respect for the people
at the table.

5. phones off the table

the conversation deserves
your full attention.

6. having one good story
to share

a painting, a moment
in history.
slides.texte_sophia:
6. having one good story
to share

i learn one a day with a
micro-learning app like
the Sophia app.
